subject: Executive approval: Crestpoint bundled pro-services + custom Epic connector
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@crestpointhealth.com>
To: dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Brad Harris <brad.harris@crestpointhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jan 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Crestpoint RFP: bundled onboarding + Epic connector

Hi Dylan,

Thanks again for last week's demo. We're looking to consolidate vendors and want Redwood to provide not only the hosted inference endpoints but also a bundled onboarding + premium support package and a custom Epic connector to push anonymized summaries into our clinical workflow. Key asks: 24/7 premium support for go-live and first 12 months, dedicated onboarding engineer, and the Epic connector work (we have API docs ready).

Budget is constrained — procurement asked whether pro services can be bundled into a single line item with a concession on professional fees. Target: Q2 go-live (May). I've attached a short RFP summary and the timeline.

Please confirm whether this is feasible and what approvals you will need.

Best,
Elena Torres
Director, Digital Transformation
Crestpoint Health

Attachments: RFP_Summary_Crestpoint.pdf (summary, timeline)
From: dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@crestpointhealth.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 10 Jan 2028 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Crestpoint RFP: bundled onboarding + Epic connector

Elena —

Appreciate the RFP and timeline. We can cover onboarding, a dedicated engineer, and the Epic connector, but the connector work requires extra engineering scope and a small third-party verification step. To move quickly, I'm proposing a bundled commercial structure: Redwood would include Premium Support (24/7) + onboarding package and perform the Epic connector build as part of the SOW. We can offer a 20% concession on pro services fees, subject to exec approval for non-standard bundling and capped engineering hours for the connector.

I've attached a draft SOW (SOW_v0.1_draft.pdf) and a preliminary price sheet (Price_Calc_Crestpoint.xlsx). I'll loop in our CS and sales leadership and finance to get the necessary approvals.

Next steps: 1) Internal approvals, 2) finalize SOW with acceptance criteria for connector, 3) DocuSign. Are you able to confirm acceptance criteria and milestone dates so we can lock the SOW?

Thanks —
Dylan Brooks
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOW_v0.1_draft.pdf, Price_Calc_Crestpoint.xlsx
From: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com, rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 11 Jan 2028 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Crestpoint RFP: bundled onboarding + Epic connector

Dylan —

Thanks for circulating the draft. High level: I support bundling to win this use case, but flagging margin impact on the engineering side. A 20% outright discount is a big concession on professional fees for a first-year engagement with a custom connector. My recommendation: limit concession to first 12 months and structure it as a credit applied to the pro services invoice (so we maintain list pricing). Also require clear milestone-based acceptance for the connector and a cap on engineering hours (we can add T&M above the cap).

I made inline notes on the SOW (see SOW_v0.1_draft.pdf) — primarily to tighten acceptance criteria and sign-off steps. Let's get finance eyes on it for an approval band.

- Karthik
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
From: rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com <rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 12 Jan 2028 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Crestpoint RFP: bundled onboarding + Epic connector — finance summary

Team —

Reviewed the numbers in Price_Calc_Crestpoint.xlsx. With a 20% concession across pro services and inclusion of the custom connector, we're looking at an ~18% blended gross margin hit on year one. We can support a concession for strategic expansion accounts, but need an approval guardrail. Proposed finance guardrail: 1) reduce concession to 15% applied only to professional services fees in year one, 2) cap the connector to 200 engineering hours (hours beyond billed at standard T&M), and 3) require acceptance testing gated payments.

I've attached a short financial summary to justify the guardrail. If Sales wants a deeper concession, we need VP-level signoff from Product Ops for the engineering risk.

- Rafael
Director, Finance

Attachments: Financial_Summary_for_approval.xlsx
From: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com, rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com
Cc: mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 13 Jan 2028 14:33:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Crestpoint RFP: bundled onboarding + Epic connector — executive approval

Folks —

Thanks for the analysis. I'm comfortable approving the following concession for Crestpoint to keep the deal momentum: 1) 15% discount on professional services, applied as a one-time credit in year one; 2) inclusion of Premium Support for the first 12 months at no incremental cost; 3) cap the Epic connector to 200 engineering hours, with T&M thereafter.

Conditions: update the SOW to include specific acceptance criteria for the connector (Lauren, please coordinate), include milestone-based payments, and have Legal (Mina) review the data handling and retention language for any PHI-related transfer. Once SOW is updated, route to DocuSign and provide a final pricing sheet.

Marissa Cole
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
From: dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@crestpointhealth.com>, Brad Harris <brad.harris@crestpointhealth.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com, rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 15 Jan 2028 15:42:00 -0800
Subject: Crestpoint: Executive approval granted (next steps + DocuSign)

Hi Elena / Brad —

Good news: executive approval has been granted with the following commercial terms: 1) 15% credit on professional services for year one, 2) Premium Support included at no additional charge for the first 12 months, and 3) Epic connector work capped at 200 engineering hours; additional hours billed at standard T&M. Acceptance testing and milestone payments will be captured in the updated SOW.

Attached: updated pricing sheet and financial summary. Lauren and Mina will follow up this week with a redline to the SOW that includes connector acceptance criteria and data handling language. Please review and we will push to DocuSign once you confirm the milestones.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/link/crestpoint-sow-2028
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/crestpoint-health/DEAL-2028-0197

Can you confirm you have internal approval on your side to sign the updated SOW by Jan 26 so we can stay on the proposed timeline?

Best regards,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: SOW_v0.1_draft.pdf (to be redlined), Price_Calc_Crestpoint.xlsx, Financial_Summary_for_approval.xlsx
